query:
SELECT 
  m1.name as molecule1, 
  m2.name as molecule2,
  ROUND(SQRT(
    POW(m1.radar_intensity - m2.radar_intensity, 2) +
    POW(m1.radar_freshness - m2.radar_freshness, 2) +
    POW(m1.radar_warmth - m2.radar_warmth, 2) +
    POW(m1.radar_sweetness - m2.radar_sweetness, 2) +
    POW(m1.radar_spiciness - m2.radar_spiciness, 2) +
    POW(m1.radar_earthiness - m2.radar_earthiness, 2)
  ), 2) as distance
FROM molecules m1
JOIN molecules m2 ON m1.id < m2.id
WHERE m1.notes LIKE '%Hermitage%' OR m2.notes LIKE '%Hermitage%'
ORDER BY distance ASC
LIMIT 20;
